history.content: Can I afford a $400 trip to Austin next weekend?

Depends on what's in the tank, Alex, I don't have visibility into your accounts, so I can't give a real yes or no.

Quick gut check though: if $400 (plus whatever you'll actually spend there, probably more like $600 all in) wouldn't touch your rent or emergency fund, it's usually fine. What's your rough monthly cushion looking like?
